AI TUTOR, MATERIALS SCIENCE - TEMPORARY

In this role, you will help enhance Grok by providing high-quality data annotations, labels, and inputs focused on materials science. You will draw on your expertise in areas such as energy materials, semiconductors, nanomaterials, metals and alloys, biomaterials, polymers, ceramics, and glasses to evaluate model outputs, identify errors in structure-property reasoning or processing assumptions, and produce clear, rigorous analyses and explanations. Your work will help train Grok to distinguish flawed or inadequately justified materials science analyses from those that are scientifically accurate, well-grounded, and practically insightful.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Use proprietary software applications to annotate and label data for designated projects
  • Support the delivery of high-quality, accurate, and well-curated datasets that meet project standards
  • Collaborate with technical teams to develop and train new tasks, contributing to the successful implementation of innovative technologies and initiatives
  • Work closely with technical staff to improve the design, functionality, and efficiency of annotation tools and workflows
  • Advance materials science research by guiding AI models in solving complex scientific problems and supporting scientific discovery and practical applications
  • Select and solve problems across various subfields of materials science aligned with your expertise, providing detailed solutions and critically evaluating AI-generated responses
  • Interpret, analyze, and execute tasks accurately in accordance with established guidelines and project requirements

POSITION DETAILS:

This is a temporary position with SpaceXSI, for the length of time as stated, and is subject to change with minimal notice as business needs dictate

  • LENGTH OF POSITION: 6 months (extensions or conversion to a permanent role may be available based on business needs)
  • LOCATION: Remote (United States, United Kingdom, Canada, Australia, and India); for US-based candidates, please note that we are unable to hire in Wyoming and Illinois at this time

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Master’s or Ph.D. in materials science, physics, chemistry, chemical engineering, or scientific discipline
  • English proficiency at CEFR C1 level or higher

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Specialized expertise in one or more subfields of materials science, including but not limited to energy materials, semiconductors, nanomaterials, metals and alloys, biomaterials, polymers, elastomers, ceramics, glasses, or other interdisciplinary materials-related fields
  • Advanced expertise in materials science demonstrated through multiple publications in reputable, peer-reviewed journals or relevant patents, preferably including one or more first-author publications
  • Strong research skills and the ability to navigate scientific literature, specialized databases, and online information resources
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, analytical, and organizational skills
  • Strong reading comprehension and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to exercise sound independent judgment when working with limited information
  • A strong interest in technological advancement, scientific progress, and innovation
  • Previous experience in AI tutoring, AI model evaluation, or related applications of artificial intelligence
  • Teaching or tutoring experience in academic or professional settings
  • Experience in technical writing, science journalism, scientific communication, or other professional writing roles

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • This role may be offered as a full-time or part-time position depending on role/business needs and candidate availability; full-time positions are preferred and require working standard business hours in your local time zone
  • We are unable to provide visa sponsorship
  • Must be willing to travel to a SpaceXSI site

US-based candidates: $45/hour - $75/hour depending on factors including relevant experience, skills, education, geographic location, and qualifications. International candidates: Information will be provided to you during the recruitment process.

Benefits vary based on employment type, location, and jurisdiction. Benefits for eligible US-based positions include health insurance, 401(k) plan, and paid sick leave. Specific details and role-specific information will be provided to you during the interview process.

This is a temporary position with SpaceXSI, for the length of time as stated, and is subject to change with minimal notice as business needs dictate

  • LOCATION: Remote (United States, United Kingdom, Canada, and Australia); for US-based candidates, please note that we are unable to hire in Wyoming and Illinois at this time

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 1+ years of professional experience (including freelance or contract work) in video editing, motion graphics, VFX, or post-production
  • Portfolio of video work, such as edited shorts, motion graphics, VFX breakdowns, or compositing reels (e.g., personal website, YouTube, Vimeo, X, ArtStation)

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Strong skills in video editing, pacing, color grading, and narrative flow
  • Hands-on proficiency with tools such as Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, After Effects, Nuke, or similar
  • Experience with compositing, rotoscoping, motion tracking, or 3D integration (matchmoving, CG compositing)
  • Familiarity with AI video generation tools (Grok Imagine, Runway, Kling, Sora, Veo, or similar)
  • Scripting or automation experience in post-production (Python, plugins, or similar)
  • Clear written and verbal communication in English, including the ability to explain technical and creative decisions

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • This role may be offered as a full-time or part-time position depending on role/business needs and candidate availability; full-time positions are preferred and require working standard business hours in your local time zone
  • We are unable to provide visa sponsorship

- Flag confident-sounding errors, anachronism, misused sources, ideological slant, and claims that outrun the evidence

- Create exemplary responses and datasets that show intellectual honesty, careful source evaluation, and a clear distinction between primary evidence, secondary interpretation, and speculation

- Steel-man opposing views before criticizing them, and mark what is settled, contested, or unknown

- Ground annotations and reference answers in primary sources whenever they exist, then weigh secondary scholarship against that record

- Collaborate with technical staff to design evaluation guidelines, rubrics, and examples that test and strengthen Grok's behavior and personality in the humanities

- Help define what good model behavior looks like in contested humanistic questions: precise, sourced, proportionately confident, and resistant to fashionable or motivated readings

- Familiarity with evaluating AI or LLM outputs, building benchmarks, or creating training data
